♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With debilitated Sun, retrograde Venus and Mercury clustered in Libra in your 7th house, your focus is pulled strongly toward one-to-one connections. Meanwhile, Mars and exalted Jupiter together in Cancer in your 4th stir up the emotional climate at home, and Saturn retrograde in Pisces keeps working through your 12th, asking you to clear old resentments. Today is about re-balancing how much of your fire you pour into others versus the sanctuary you keep for yourself.

💼 Career: Partners, clients, or a key colleague may drive the day’s agenda. Libra’s airy diplomacy helps you mediate disagreements or renegotiate terms, but the debilitated Sun suggests you can’t bulldoze through—listening will earn you more influence than pushing. Venus retrograde favors revisiting old agreements or reviving a collaboration with updated boundaries. Mars–Jupiter in your 4th can bring strong opinions from family about your work direction; hear them, but let practical realities lead. A quiet, organized workspace will make it easier to navigate any back-and-forth at the office.

❤️ Love: Relationship dynamics are lit up. If you’re coupled, imbalances in attention, time or emotional effort may be impossible to ignore. Use Mercury in Libra to name what you need with fairness, not accusation. Venus retrograde can bring echoes of an old pattern—notice if you’re slipping into rescuing, chasing, or withdrawing when things get tense. If single, you may feel drawn to someone reflective and cooperative, or an old flame might cross your mind or timeline. Let actions over the next few weeks show you whether they’ve truly grown.

💰 Money: Shared costs, joint decisions and long-term security themes come forward. Agreements around rent, mortgages, or business partnerships may need a second look. Jupiter’s strength in your 4th is good for long-range financial planning tied to property or family, but Mars there can tempt you into hasty home-related spending. Before agreeing to a shared purchase or loan, double-check numbers and make sure everyone is genuinely on board. Avoid using gifts or money to smooth over relationship tensions; instead, talk through the underlying issue.

🧘 Advice: You don’t have to choose between your needs and others’—you do have to stop hiding your needs and hoping someone will guess them.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The moment you bring honest terms to the table, you find out who is willing to meet you there.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Libra stack—Sun, retrograde Venus (your ruler), and Mercury—lights up your 6th house of work, routines and wellbeing, while Mars and exalted Jupiter charge your 3rd house of effort, learning and short journeys. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 11th keeps refining your long-term goals and social circle. Today’s current favors methodical improvement over big declarations.

💼 Career: This is a systems and details day. The 6th-house activation asks you to look honestly at workflows, handoffs with colleagues and the realistic time each task needs. With the Sun debilitated, pushing yourself to over-perform for recognition could backfire; instead, let the quality and consistency of your work speak. Venus retrograde is ideal for fixing something in your schedule or job description that has not felt fair. Mars–Jupiter in your 3rd give courage to have practical conversations with teammates, propose a new process, or finally commit to learning that tool that would actually save you hours.

❤️ Love: You may show care more through reliability than romance today. If partnered, discussions about chores, health habits or work stress can either bring you closer or turn nitpicky—choose language that says “us against the problem” rather than “you are the problem.” If single, attraction may spark with someone you see regularly in everyday spaces—a coworker, someone at a class, or in your neighborhood—where you can observe how they handle responsibilities. You’re less interested in grand gestures and more in whether words and follow-through match.

💰 Money: Finances are tied closely to effort and skill-building. Review how your current workload translates into income—are you undercharging, overextending, or carrying tasks that bring little return? Venus retrograde can highlight a recurring expense or obligation you’ve tolerated out of habit that no longer makes sense. Mars–Jupiter in the 3rd support modest investments in training, transport, or communication tools that increase your earning capacity over time. Small, repeated actions—tracking expenses, setting reminders, honoring your own rates—quietly restructure your financial base.

🧘 Advice: Treat today’s ordinary duties as a negotiation with your future self: what are you promising them by how you spend your energy now?

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your routines start honoring your worth, other people begin to honor it too.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: Sun, retrograde Venus and your ruler Mercury in Libra ignite your 5th house of creativity, joy and self-expression. Mars and exalted Jupiter in Cancer activate your 2nd house of income and values, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces presides over your 10th, keeping career direction under serious review. Today invites you to connect what lights you up with what sustains you materially.

💼 Career: Ideas want to play—but also to pay. The 5th-house emphasis boosts your inventive thinking, whether in marketing, design, teaching, or any field where originality matters. Mercury in Libra helps you package concepts attractively, while Venus retrograde suggests dusting off an old pitch or creative project that could be revived with a smarter structure. Mars–Jupiter in your 2nd energize the money side—good for asserting your worth, adjusting rates, or defining what is and isn’t included in your role. Just be careful of scattering your attention across too many side ventures; choose one promising lane and give it focused effort.

❤️ Love: Romance feels more spontaneous and expressive. If attached, you might be eager to reintroduce fun—shared hobbies, flirting, or planning something light-hearted together. Old disagreements about “who makes things exciting” could resurface; use Venus retrograde to co-create pleasure rather than placing blame. If single, you’re drawn to witty, charming, or artistic people, possibly through social events or creative spaces. Be aware that with the Sun debilitated, some connections may be more about mutual ego strokes than real compatibility; give it time to reveal depth.

💰 Money: With Mars and Jupiter in your 2nd, money matters carry extra momentum. This can support decisive moves—negotiating better terms, trimming expenses that don’t match your values, or launching a small income experiment tied to a talent. At the same time, the 5th-house activation increases the temptation for impulse splurges on entertainment, fashion or experiences. A simple rule for today: if a purchase doesn’t either nourish your craft or create real rest, pause before swiping.

🧘 Advice: Let delight be a compass, but insist that every bright idea earns a simple plan before you commit your time or money.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop treating your gifts as side entertainment and start giving them structure, they start giving back.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: Mars and exalted Jupiter travel through your own sign, firing up courage and a desire to move life forward. At the same time, the Libra trio—debilitated Sun, retrograde Venus and Mercury—in your 4th house brings attention to home, family and emotional roots, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 9th questions old beliefs. Today’s tide pushes you to align your inner base with the bolder version of yourself emerging.

💼 Career: With Mars–Jupiter in your 1st, others may look to you for initiative, ideas, or leadership, whether or not you hold the title. Use this surge wisely: choose one decision you’ve been postponing and move it forward rather than trying to fix everything at once. The 4th-house Libra emphasis reminds you that your professional drive is deeply affected by your domestic atmosphere. You may need a conversation about boundaries at home, or to reconfigure your workspace to support focus. Saturn in the 9th favors concrete steps toward training, certification, or a shift in direction that has been calling you quietly.

❤️ Love: Your emotional temperature is high, but so is your need for safety. If partnered, discussions may center on home matters, family involvement, or where you see yourselves in the next few years. Watch for a tendency to push your view strongly (Mars) while expecting others to automatically accommodate; let Jupiter’s wisdom soften your delivery. If single, you could attract people drawn to your protective warmth. Choose those who respect your sensitivity rather than seeing it as something to manage for their comfort.

💰 Money: Financial considerations are woven through both home and self-development. Jupiter’s exaltation can bring opportunities related to real estate, relocation, or improving your living conditions, but Mars can also inflame spending on comforts or symbolic “fresh starts.” Before committing to big changes, check if they truly improve stability or just offer emotional relief. Saturn in the 9th supports investing in meaningful learning or travel with a clear purpose; avoid impulsive leaps into expensive adventures without a plan.

🧘 Advice: Let your desire to protect others include your own time, rest and dreams; that’s where your real strength grows.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The more you build a home life that actually holds you, the less you need external approval to feel secure.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The debilitated Sun—your planetary significator—travels through Libra alongside retrograde Venus and Mercury in your 3rd house of communication, siblings and daily interactions. Mars and exalted Jupiter move through your 12th, churning up the unconscious and highlighting hidden efforts, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces intensifies realism around shared responsibilities in your 8th. Today’s fire runs quietly through your thoughts, words and private processing.

💼 Career: Conversations, emails and quick decisions may feel more loaded than usual. With your Sun weakened in the 3rd, you’re asked to lean on tact and listening rather than your usual authority. Venus retrograde supports revisiting an old proposal, clearing up a past misunderstanding, or reconnecting with a contact you’ve lost touch with. Mars–Jupiter in your 12th say that behind-the-scenes work—research, planning, closures—carries disproportionate impact now. Protect pockets of uninterrupted time to untangle a complex issue or finish something you’ve quietly carried too long.

❤️ Love: In relationships, how you communicate matters more than what you intend. Old conversational patterns—interrupting, withdrawing, dramatizing, or using humor to dodge vulnerability—may become obvious. If partnered, you have an opening to speak with more nuance about everyday frictions instead of waiting until they explode. If single, you might encounter someone through your neighborhood, short trips or online exchanges. With Mars active in the 12th, private longings or unspoken attractions are possible; give yourself space to feel them without needing to act instantly.

💰 Money: Saturn in your 8th continues to sober up themes around debts, shared finances or taxes. Today favors reviewing paperwork, clarifying who is responsible for what, and spotting vague assumptions in agreements. The Libra planets in your 3rd are excellent for asking questions and comparing options—loans, subscriptions, contracts—before committing. Watch for stress spending or late-night online shopping as Mars–Jupiter in the 12th stirs restlessness; redirect that urge into making a concrete plan to close one lingering financial loose end.

🧘 Advice: Let your pride rest and your curiosity lead; you’ll learn more from what you hear today than from what you say.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop needing every exchange to affirm you, your words stop performing and start connecting.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: Libra hosts the debilitated Sun, retrograde Venus and your ruler Mercury in your 2nd house of income, speech and priorities. Mars and exalted Jupiter in Cancer activate your 11th house of friendships, networks and long-term gains, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces continues its sober review of your partnerships in the 7th. Today links what you value, who you stand beside, and the future you’re quietly building.

💼 Career: Group dynamics and financial clarity intersect strongly now. The 11th-house Mars–Jupiter combination energizes teamwork, community projects or online endeavors, but can also highlight where you’ve taken on too much for the sake of harmony. With the Sun weak in your 2nd, don’t undercut your own contribution when discussing pay or recognition; Mercury in Libra helps you present facts calmly and persuasively. Venus retrograde is ideal for adjusting an old contract, revisiting a former client, or rethinking a revenue model so it aligns better with your current skills.

❤️ Love: Saturn in your 7th keeps asking: are your agreements—spoken and unspoken—actually realistic? Today, with the 2nd house lit, issues of self-worth and practical needs in relationships may come up. If attached, conversations around budgets, lifestyle choices, or how each of you supports the other’s goals can deepen understanding if you’re willing to hear uncomfortable truths. If single, you may find your standards rising; superficial charm without evidence of stability will likely feel thin. You’re allowed to want both kindness and competence.

💰 Money: This is a solid day for recalibrating finances. Use the Libra planets in your 2nd to review how you talk about money with others—and with yourself. Are you minimizing, over-explaining, or avoiding? Venus retrograde can highlight a pattern of spending to maintain appearances or to smooth tension. Mars–Jupiter in the 11th point to gains through networks, social platforms or collaboration, but also to peer pressure spending. Decide which invitations truly serve your long-term aims and which simply drain your resources.

🧘 Advice: Let your budget and your boundaries reflect the same truth about your worth; anything that doesn’t fit that standard is ready for revision.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The day you stop apologizing for needing fair exchange is the day your effort starts attracting better offers.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The spotlight sits squarely on you: debilitated Sun, retrograde Venus (your ruler) and Mercury all occupy your own sign, turning attention to your body, presence and immediate choices. Mars and exalted Jupiter in Cancer power up your 10th house of career and public image, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces shapes your 6th house of work habits and health. You are in an active self-rewrite, and the world is responding.

💼 Career: Ambition and visibility are heightened, but so is scrutiny. Mars–Jupiter at the top of your chart can bring opportunities to step into leadership, handle big clients or take on a high-impact assignment. The weakened Sun in your 1st suggests you’ll fare better through collaboration, tact and preparedness than through forceful self-promotion. Venus retrograde favors returning to a past role or project from a stronger sense of your boundaries and needs. Saturn in the 6th asks you to pair any career leap with sustainable routines—sleep, schedule, delegation—so you don’t burn out while trying to prove yourself.

❤️ Love: Your relationships are reacting to your internal shifts. If attached, your partner may notice you renegotiating how much energy you give, what you’ll tolerate, or how openly you express preferences. Be honest that you’re in a transition, not issuing ultimatums; invite them into the process. If single, you’re more magnetic than you realize, but Venus retrograde advises slowing down before committing. Use this transit to observe what kind of attention actually feels nourishing and what just feeds old patterns of people-pleasing.

💰 Money: Professional moves have direct financial consequences now. You may feel ready to ask for better compensation, update your pricing, or say no to underpaid work that once felt “good exposure.” Mars–Jupiter in the 10th can bring both opportunity and pressure; resist agreeing to terms on the spot. Saturn in the 6th supports practical budgeting and consistent effort toward paying down debts or building savings. Invest first in what keeps you functional—tools, skills, health—before image upgrades.

🧘 Advice: Let this be a season where you experiment with stronger boundaries and see who adjusts; that data is more valuable than praise.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop trading self-respect for approval, the relationships that remain become your real support system.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Libra trio—debilitated Sun, retrograde Venus and Mercury—falls in your 12th house of rest, endings and the subconscious, while Mars (your traditional ruler) and exalted Jupiter in Cancer activate your 9th house of belief, learning and horizons. Saturn retrograde in Pisces stirs your 5th house of creativity and joy, asking for a more authentic expression. Today favors stepping slightly back from the noise so you can sense your next chapter more clearly.

💼 Career: Outwardly you may keep moving, but the real work is internal strategy. The 12th-house emphasis is excellent for closing out stale commitments, tying loose ends, or quietly preparing a pivot—updating a portfolio, researching opportunities, exploring study options. Mars–Jupiter in your 9th push you to think bigger about where your path could lead: teaching, publishing, international links, or deeper spiritual alignment with your work. You don’t need all the answers; you do need to admit which direction no longer fits your spirit.

❤️ Love: Your emotional landscape is more private and reflective. Past relationships, dreams, or subtle disappointments may surface—not to drag you backward, but to reveal what you’ve been tolerating. If partnered, you may feel the need for a bit more solitude or quiet time with your thoughts; explain that this is about processing, not withdrawal from the relationship. If single, you might feel less drawn to dating and more to healing recurring patterns, perhaps through journaling, therapy, or spiritual practices.

💰 Money: Financially, this is a good day for behind-the-scenes clean-up. Review automatic payments, forgotten subscriptions, or shared expenses that have become lopsided. The 12th-house Sun–Venus can reveal where money leaks through avoidance or trying to maintain appearances. Mars–Jupiter in the 9th favor learning about long-term strategies—retirement, taxes, or investments—rather than jumping into risky schemes. Choose education and understanding over urgency.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to pause a storyline before it burns you out; clarity often arrives when you finally stop pushing.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Not every door that’s closing is a loss—some are simply making space for the path you were never brave enough to name.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Libra cluster—debilitated Sun, retrograde Venus and Mercury—activates your 11th house of friendships, networks and future plans, while your ruler exalted Jupiter joins Mars in Cancer in your 8th house of shared resources and deep transformation. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 4th presses you to take emotional foundations seriously. Today’s sky asks: do the people around you and the way you share energy truly match where you say you’re headed?

💼 Career: Group projects, alliances and long-term goals are highlighted. The 11th-house focus can bring reconnection with former teams or communities, or the chance to step back into a network that once mattered. Venus retrograde suggests you renegotiate your role—less unpaid emotional labor, more clarity on expectations. Mars–Jupiter in the 8th emphasize collaborations involving shared budgets, research, or confidential information. It’s a powerful day for strategy sessions, but also one where you must watch power dynamics: insist on transparency around who benefits and who takes the risk.

❤️ Love: Intimacy, trust and future direction intertwine. If partnered, you may be prompted to talk about deeper matters—shared finances, emotional burdens, or how you both envision the next few years. Some buried feelings could surface; meet them with steady curiosity instead of philosophizing them away. If single, attraction could arise through friends, online communities, or in contexts involving healing or finance. With the 8th house active, chemistry may be intense; take your time to see whether vulnerability is reciprocated and respected.

💰 Money: Shared money, debts, inheritances, or partner income may demand attention. Mars–Jupiter in the 8th can bring opportunities to restructure a loan, consolidate obligations, or invest jointly—but they can also amplify risk if you act on enthusiasm alone. The Libra planets in your 11th encourage you to align financial decisions with long-term visions, not just immediate relief. Be selective about lending to friends or mixing money with social groups today; set clear terms if you do.

🧘 Advice: Let honesty go beyond optimism—naming the uncomfortable details of an agreement is how you protect your freedom.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you match your generosity with equal clarity, you stop feeling used and start feeling powerful.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The debilitated Sun, retrograde Venus and Mercury in Libra occupy the very top of your chart—your 10th house of career and public role. Across the sky, Mars and exalted Jupiter in Cancer animate your 7th house of partnerships, while your ruler Saturn retrograde in Pisces works through your 3rd house of communication. Today presents a live test of how you lead, negotiate and speak under pressure.

💼 Career: Visibility is high, but so is the need for nuance. The 10th-house emphasis may bring decisions about title, authority, or responsibilities. Venus retrograde can revive an old role, client, or project for review; this time, you have more data about what it costs you. With the Sun weakened, humility paired with competence will take you further than rigid control. Mars–Jupiter in your 7th amplify the voices of partners, rivals, or collaborators—some may champion you, others may challenge you. Aim for alliances where expectations, credit and timelines are spelled out, not assumed.

❤️ Love: Relationships mirror your current approach to duty and ambition. If attached, conversations about workload, time together, or major life decisions may come to the forefront. You may realize you’ve been carrying more than your share or expecting your partner to adapt without being fully informed. If single, you could be attracted to people you meet through work or formal settings who seem accomplished or decisive. Saturn in your 3rd encourages calm, direct dialogue; avoid testing people through silence or over-analysis.

💰 Money: Professional choices now have clear financial consequences. This is a good time to revisit compensation structures, performance-based pay, or the profitability of certain clients. Venus retrograde helps you see where you’ve underpriced yourself for the sake of stability. Mars–Jupiter in the 7th can indicate negotiations around contracts or business partnerships; be thorough with documentation, especially around exit clauses. Don’t be rushed into signing; asking for time to review the fine print is in your favor.

🧘 Advice: Measure success not only by what you achieve, but by how aligned your agreements are with your actual capacity and ethics.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop proving you can carry everything, the opportunities that remain are the ones worthy of your strength.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Libra trio—debilitated Sun, retrograde Venus and Mercury—activates your 9th house of beliefs, education and horizons, while Mars and exalted Jupiter in Cancer energize your 6th house of work and health. Saturn retrograde in your own sign continues reshaping your identity and responsibilities. Today nudges you to align your daily reality with a philosophy that actually feels true now, not one you inherited years ago.

💼 Career: It’s a strong day for planning, study and course correction. The 9th-house focus encourages you to look beyond immediate tasks: where is your field going, and what skills will future-you be grateful to have? Venus retrograde may bring back an old mentor, course idea, or half-finished qualification asking for completion or a conscious goodbye. Mars–Jupiter in the 6th support efficient, courageous changes in your routines—streamlining processes, addressing a persistent inefficiency, or setting clearer boundaries with colleagues around your availability.

❤️ Love: You’re inclined to seek partners who share your outlook or at least respect your evolving path. If coupled, conversations about travel, relocation, education, or spiritual beliefs may arise, revealing whether you’re growing in compatible directions. If single, you may feel drawn to people from different cultures, academic environments, or online spaces centered on learning. With the Sun weak, be cautious of putting someone on a pedestal because they sound inspiring; look for consistency between their ideals and their everyday choices.

💰 Money: Financially, attention goes to the link between work habits and long-term possibilities. Investing in skills, tools or health measures that genuinely expand your capacity is supported, as long as you do your homework on costs and benefits. Mars–Jupiter in the 6th can bring extra workload in the name of gain—be mindful of saying yes to everything and then paying in exhaustion. Question any belief that equates worth with constant productivity; Saturn in your 1st asks for a more sustainable definition of success.

🧘 Advice: Let your schedule be your quiet manifesto—what you prioritize hour by hour is what you truly believe in.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your everyday choices start matching your higher vision, change stops feeling dramatic and starts feeling natural.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The debilitated Sun, retrograde Venus and Mercury in Libra travel through your 8th house of shared resources, intimacy and deep transformation. Mars and your ruler exalted Jupiter in Cancer ignite your 5th house of creativity, romance and authentic joy, while Saturn retrograde in your sign keeps you aware of your limits and responsibilities. Today’s waters are intense but rich with potential for honest renewal.

💼 Career: Projects involving research, joint finances, or behind-the-scenes problem-solving may come to the fore. The 8th-house emphasis supports renegotiating terms with partners, clients or institutions—asking for clearer division of responsibilities or more equitable compensation. Venus retrograde can revive an old financial arrangement or confidential matter to be handled with more maturity. Mars–Jupiter in your 5th bring a surge of creative courage; it’s an excellent day to pitch a bold idea, design something distinctive, or take on a role that showcases your unique style, provided you’re realistic about follow-through.

❤️ Love: Emotional depth is highlighted. If partnered, you might find yourselves talking about vulnerabilities, fears, or past hurts that still influence the present. Handle these conversations gently; they’re an opportunity to build a stronger bond, not to tally grievances. The 5th-house activation also boosts passion and playfulness, reminding you that joy can coexist with serious talks. If single, you may be drawn to magnetic, complex people or to romantic possibilities emerging through creative or spiritual circles. Let time reveal whether intensity comes with reliability.

💰 Money: Shared money, debts, taxes or inheritances could require attention. The Libra planets in your 8th are favorable for balancing the scales—clarifying who owes what, consolidating obligations, or questioning fees and terms. Avoid making large speculative moves purely on a hunch; Mars–Jupiter in the 5th can increase appetite for risk, from investments to big spending on entertainment or children. Channel that fire into smaller, calculated steps and into investing in your own talents rather than in shaky promises.

🧘 Advice: Meet today’s intensity with grounded self-respect; you can explore deep territory without surrendering your sense of center.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop treating your depth as something to hide or rush through, it becomes the source of your most inspired choices.
